name: St. Patrick's Basilica, Montreal
scope: The Montréal Irish Catholic church circa 1895, including its greystone nave, central rose and tower, pointed portals, side aisles and slender spire.

references.dateBasis: The original print is catalogued circa 1895. The chosen date sets the modeled year.

originalReview.notes: The signed albumen stereograph shows the historic approach, tall square entrance tower, belfry, pointed spire and side roof through the leafless trees.

review.method: Exact local public-domain nineteenth-century print with CC0 digitization
review.notes: The exact local Qualla stereograph matches the digitizer’s CC0 Commons original. The period albumen print is signed J. G. Parks. McCord Stewart records James George Parks’s death in 1895. The other historical file is a crop of this view. The remaining files concern other Montréal buildings.
